### 2. Scope of services

Provide selected survey evidence; detail observations, legal boundary/title, utility detection and set-out are distinct purchases. Confirm task/jurisdiction competence. Fence lines or title searches are not boundary proof; legal adviser owns rights advice.
Designers own design; locator detects, surveyor captures, plumber provides sewer evidence. Name client-direct/subcontract work. Tank geometry is not hydraulic capacity, integrity or watertightness certification.
Survey brief: Attach marked extent/features, purpose/users, title/DP/easements, dated records/conflicts, coordinate system/zone/epoch, vertical datum/control/transformation and accuracy by purpose.

I = included; O = optional price; X = excluded; ? = scope unknown. Resolve unknown scope before issue; propose departures in R6.

|---|---|---|---|---|

### 4. Allowances

Complete quantities/extent before issue; return gaps and price alternatives without reducing coverage. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate with quantity; estimated totals are not fixed fees.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Extent / features | 2 survey areas; marked plan/revision/area, contours/levels, rooms/floors, roofs/elevations, adjoining windows/trees; accuracy by feature |
| Control / cadastral | 2 control marks; datum checks, titles/lots/DPs/instruments, boundary length/points and plan/report types |
| Visits / access | 2 visits; crew/hours/shifts, simultaneous specialists, permissions/inductions/traffic/access equipment/shutdowns by party |
| Underground assets | 2 pits; service areas/lengths/types, methods, pipe runs/tanks, exposures/depths and inaccessible-feature contingency |
| Issues / review | 2 PDF/CAD/data issues; point-cloud format/extent, review rounds, meetings/duration, query-hour ceiling and revisions |
| Set-out option | 2 visits/hold points; elements/points, booking notice, independent checks, control reinstatement/reinspection basis |
| Monitoring option | 2 rounds; baseline/date, marks, frequency/duration, reports, accuracy/environmental limits and engineer trigger/action plan |
| Completion / titling | 2 plans/certificates; areas/assets, lots/units/easements, submission rounds, final data and endpoint |

### 5. Terms

- Agree Project survey appointment (attached), version/precedence and departures before instruction. Supplier terms, personal liability and non-solicitation require express agreement.
- Written authority before extra scope/quantities/ceilings/fees/program changes; state cause, alternatives and effects. Site dockets alone do not authorise variations. Stop unsafe affected work, notify; agree handback/standby/remobilisation.
- Information, extent/feature/method/allowance schedules, stages and addenda set the baseline; agreed development/review is included.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Correct invoices for completed work payable within 30 days, subject to agreement/applicable requirements. Disclose advance payment, withholding, interest, suspension/cancellation departures.
- Disclose minimums/standby/after-hours and agreed escalation mechanism; no automatic annual increase.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Dated/revisioned PDFs and agreed editable CAD/data; datum/units/methods/accuracy, measured versus inferred and missing features. Agree project distribution licence, separate reliance, confidentiality/security, retention and handover.
- Manage resources/subcontractors; notify substitutions/conflicts/insurance changes. Disclose caps/indemnities/time bars/loss exclusions/novation/IP. Agree notice/cure, completed-work costs, handback/records, dispute negotiation/mediation and urgent relief.

### Returnable schedules: reply using this structure only

R2 Deliverables list: Selected plans/certificates, CAD/PDF/cloud/data, datum/accuracy, detection/sewer, missing features, set-out/as-built/monitoring and title records: purpose, editability, recipient, dates/rounds, reliance/limits.
R3 Hourly rates: Extra visits/hours/features/areas/pits/plans, travel/minimums, control replacement, standby/cancellation/after-hours/equipment/repeats; ceilings/escalation. Separate quantity, rate and each markup.
R4 Team: Name lead/reviewer, cadastral practitioner, crew, locator/plumber, subcontractors and availability; assign records/permissions/access/exposure/isolation/restoration, detection/measurement/checks/interpretation/lodgement. QA ISO or equivalent.
R5 Experience: Two or three examples with referees matched to purpose, accuracy, hidden-service/boundary/existing/live constraints and scale; role and delivered evidence.
R6 Departures: Sections 2–5/agreement: comply/departure, reason, alternative, owner and fee/time effect, or nil. Include extent/datum conflicts, boundaries/hidden assets/methods, duplicate scope/markups/reliance. Assumptions state quantity, consequence, decision owner/date.
R7 Program: Input/permission/control/revision dates, mobilisation/simultaneous specialists, field/draft/review/final/options; start/pause conditions, booking notice, currency/revisit triggers and authority dependencies.
R8 Insurance and compliance: Current PI $5 million (client selected), PL $20 million (client selected), workers compensation as applicable; project-selected limits agreed before issue, claim/aggregate/exclusions, registration/competence/continuity. Historical certificates are not current cover.
R9 Reimbursables: Searches, locator/plumber, authority/lodgement, travel/parking, traffic/access/safety, exposure/isolation/restoration and data: included/allowance/rate, payer/quantity/GST/markup/approval; client-direct work, no R1 duplication or stacked charges.
